notes.title: Game Update - Early Access: Fully Loaded!
notes.notes:
[h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539706/79547cb53b2407c1c4cb7da87d71e8d84510cbd0.jpg"][/img]
August game update is live! Here are the highlights: 
[/h2][h3][b]Pledge allegiance to a Faction, raise your reputation & unlock faction drip[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Going deeper into the Faction lore, the full faction Reputation system unlocks next release
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]New Battle Zone: Big Carrot Energy Stadium[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Explore the Rogue Jumpers faction area in Hangout and competitive modes.
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Updated Skateboard Physics[/b][/h3][list][*][p]It’s way more physical now[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Skateboard and Water Pistol Skins added to the game[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Change your skins in the inventory 
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]All reload animations are now hooked up and in the game[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Certain weapons can now be interrupted and only half reloaded
[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Weapon Movement Speed Modifiers added[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Weapons now impact your movement speed, helps melee weapons the most[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Melee Weapons Buffed[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Attack mid-air with the improved leap and cut the distance to enemies at ease[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Performance Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Your average FPS should slightly higher all around now[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Founders Pass has been removed from menu[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We transition to a new Faction Progression system in the next release[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Let us know on discord how you feel about the updates:[/h3][h3][url="https://discord.gg/wMpCE6qSEs"]https://discord.gg/wMpCE6qSEs[/url][/h3][h3]PS. Show your support and wishlist the game on Steam[/h3][p]
[/p]
